findings: The company reports that its flagship AG 365 agricultural drone platform is a Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) certified multi-utility medium-category drone capable of liquid pesticide spraying, granular fertilizer spreading, direct seeding, and crop health monitoring through field-swappable configurations. The standard AG 365, compact AG 365S, and portable AG 365H variants feature payload tank capacities ranging between 10 to 11 liters, while its recently introduced MD30 model provides a 30-liter field-swappable tank configuration for spraying, seeding, and spreading.

The company's online product documentation indicates additional variations in its agricultural lineup, including an upcoming 50-liter version designed to carry 25 kg payloads and a hybrid model targeting an extended 90-minute flight time.

The rating rests on the company's verified deployment of a multi-utility drone platform available in 10-liter, 11-liter, and 30-liter capacities supporting interchangeable payloads for spraying, granular spreading, and seeding.
